items.headline: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
items.excerpt: AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. PDD Kit helps ensure the code is doing what the developer intended by creating formal specifications and testing against them.
